_comment: Demo-data enrichment applied before the MetaPlus migration classifies nodes.
This graph is a demonstration graph, and some of its nodes were stubs: a name
and a tag, with no metadata to decide anything from. Rather than loosening the
migration's conversion rule — which deliberately converts only nodes that
declare themselves formal classifications — the missing declaration is supplied
here, explicitly and reviewably, and the normal rule then applies.
The COICOP division codes below are the real COICOP 2018 divisions published by
the UN Statistics Division, not invented ones.

nodes.description: Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP), 2018 revision. Classifies household consumption expenditure by purpose. Used to structure the consumption basket underlying the Consumer Price Index.
nodes.summary: UN classification of household consumption expenditure by purpose; basis of the CPI basket

metadata.official_name: Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose
metadata.purpose: Classify household consumption expenditure by purpose for national accounts, household budget surveys and consumer price statistics.
metadata.legal_basis: Adopted by the UN Statistical Commission at its 49th session (2018)
